description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of self-reflection supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data across six reasoning categories, as presented in the paper “SRPO: Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware Reinforcement Learning.” The vertical axis, labeled “Number of Samples,” is plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10² to 10⁴, with gridlines at 100, 1,000, and 10,000. The horizontal axis lists the reasoning categories in descending order of sample count: Mathematical Reasoning (7,025 samples), General Reasoning (1,709), Natural Scene Reasoning (413), Physical Reasoning (232), Logical Puzzle Reasoning (91), and Chemical Reasoning (49). Each category is represented by a light blue vertical bar, with the exact sample count labeled above each bar. The data shows a steep decline in sample size from Mathematical Reasoning — the most represented category — to Chemical Reasoning, which has the fewest samples. No grouping or stacking is present; each bar stands independently, and all bars are uniformly colored and styled, with no visual emphasis on any particular category beyond their height and labeled value.
